chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Safwan, from Al-A'ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who mortgaged his slave girl to a group of people: Is it permissible for him to copulate with her? He said: 'Those who hold her as security would hinder between him and her.' I said: 'What is your view if he was able to be alone with her?' He said: 'Yes, I do not see a problem with it.'
ai.seo_question: Can a man have sexual relations with his slave girl if she is mortgaged to others?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies the distinction between possession and usufruct in the context of mortgage (rahn), affirming that the creditor's right is limited to securing the debt rather than restricting the owner's inherent sexual rights over his slave. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that unless explicitly stipulated otherwise, the transfer of possession for security does not extinguish the owner's right to intimate access, provided he can secure privacy. The dialogue underscores the practical application of property rights in early Islamic society, where slavery and debt were intertwined legal realities.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Safwan, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who mortgaged his slave girl to a group of people, it is Permissible for him that he copulates with her?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Those who are holding her as a security deposit would hinder between him and her’. I said, ‘What is your<sup>asws</sup> view if he was able upon that, alone’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, I<sup>asws</sup> do not see a problem with it’.
en.sarwar: 20. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Safwan from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who had left his slave-girl as al- Rahn (security deposit) with a people; if he could have sexual intercourse with her. He (the Imam) said, ‘Those who hold her as al-Rahn (security deposit) bar him from reaching her.’ I asked, ‘What happens if he gets a chance? He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, I do not see it as unlawful.’”
